lawyer:
M. A. Aziz ------ For the appellant. 
Habibur Rahman Khan ------ For respondents No. 1(1), 1(3), 1(5), 1(7) & 2.
parties:
Gaher Ali Mandal  ------ Appellant.
Vs.
Manik Sikder and others ------ Respondent
full_judgment: 5. Mr. M. A. Aziz, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the plaintiff-appellant has submitted that both the courts below having found valid, title in favour of the plaintiff, the learned Subordinate Judge erred in holding that the suit was not maintainable. He has further urged that it was not a proper judgment of reversal inasmuch as the learned Subordinate Judge has not taken into considered some of the important documents filed on behalf of the plaintiff in support of his possession of the suit land. Mr. Habibur Rahman Khan, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the respondent has supported the findings of the court of appeal below and has submitted that the plaintiff having been found to be out of possession by the learned Subordinate Judge, the suit has been rightly dismissed as not maintainable.
